notes: Item 19 is present and discloses financial performance for 9 Covered Businesses (6 franchised, 3 affiliate-owned) for the 12-month period January 1 - December 31, 2025. Individual monthly and annual gross sales data for the 6 franchised locations were successfully extracted from images (pages 61-66). However, the summary statistics tables (average, median, min, max, and operational metrics like container count, tons per haul, hauls per month per container) on pages 70-76 appear to contain tabular data in images that was not captured by OCR — only section headers were extracted. The 3 affiliate-owned location tables (Birmingham AL, Huntsville AL, Indianapolis IN) on pages 67-69 also appear to have image-only tables that were not OCR'd. The text confirms 6 franchised Covered Businesses covering 20 Territories and 3 affiliate-owned covering 16 Territories. The Indianapolis affiliate location is flagged as non-representative due to shared staffing with Smash My Trash affiliate and use as a training/testing facility. Confidence is moderate due to missing summary statistics and affiliate location tables.
